facts.fact: The Kenya News Agency reports that the Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032 was unveiled and launched by ICT Cabinet Secretary Joe Mucheru at the Connected Kenya summit in Kwale; no adopting act by cabinet or parliament is named.
The report describes the Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032 as a ten-year plan and as the sequential successor to the 2014-2017 master plan.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Innovation and Youth Affairs
